title: Fell apart straight out of packaging
text: Fell apart straight out of packaging. Cheap. I took the plastic off and the ends fell off and won't stay on. The sleeve keeps coming out so the two poles don't stay together. I super glued the end caps back on and the sleeve inside the pole, but it doesn't even twist to stay up. Not sturdy, defi6 not even worth $5.

product_metadata.title: Kenney KN607C/10V1 Fashion Tension Shower Curtain Rod, 24 to 40-Inch, White
features: The Kenney Twist & Fit No Tools Tension Shower Curtain Rod in white is adjustable from 24-40” wide to fit compact and standing shower openings
Available in multiple colors and finishes to coordinate with existing or new bathroom decor
Made of heavy-duty steel it is both durable and rust resistant
Non-slip, non-scratch end caps help protect your wall and tile from damage over time
No tools are needed to setup, making this rod easy to install: no tools, no drilling, no damage
description: The Kenney Twist & Fit No Tools Stall Tension Shower Curtain Rod is adjustable from 24 inches to 40 inches wide, making it a great solution for compact, standing, or stall showers. Made of heavy-duty steel, it is designed to be both durable and rust resistant. Fashionable colors and finishes make it simple to find coordinating rings and shower curtains to match the rest of your bathroom. The non-slip, non-scratch end caps mean no damage to your wall or tile. The end caps include ring locks to keep your shower curtain against the wall, preventing drafts. Twist and Fit makes installation easy – without the need for tools. To install, extend against both walls and twist to secure in place.
